title: Epstein files show interest in people with psi abilities

tellings.quote: provably in the files there there was an interest in people with sigh or empathy or consciousness abilities um by the Epstein network

plain: Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official, says the Epstein files show that Jeffrey Epstein's network took an interest in people with psi abilities, meaning claimed powers of the mind such as telepathy, along with empathy or "consciousness abilities." He tells Michels it is "provably in the files." If true, it would tie Epstein's circle to the hunt for people with unusual mental gifts.
